name: context-diet
description: Flags big tool results and files read three or more times, and suggests /compact when the context passes a threshold (60% by default); a band lists the top offenders.

thresholdPercent.title: Suggest /compact at (% of context)
thresholdPercent.description: The context fill at which the band suggests compacting.

bigResultTokens.title: Big tool result (tokens)
bigResultTokens.description: A tool result above this many tokens (estimated at 4 characters each) is flagged.
